summary: Phase 4 continues the read-only PostgreSQL gear template selector split. server/pg_gear_template_selectors.py now owns build_admin_gear_template_display_records_read_model(), which turns hydrated admin gate gear templates into backend-owned display records by preserving raw display slots, grouping community/baseline templates by class/spec, selecting admin community display rows with strict_active=false, and selecting baseline display rows. server/postgres_cache_store.py keeps admin gate SQL reads, table existence checks, official metadata SQL queries, offhand coverage repair as an adapter callback, cache writes, and sync/write/backfill paths.
